name: Flux 3 Video
description: Generate video from a text prompt, animate an image, or transition between a start and end frame with Flux 3.

action.description: Generate video from a text prompt, animate an image, or transition between a start and end frame with Flux 3.
action.name: blackforestlabs/flux-3/text-to-video
action.searchText: flux 3 video  flux flux 3 flux.3 black forest labs bfl video text to video image to video t2v i2v first last frame

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. 'auto' lets the model choose.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds. 'auto' lets the model choose, and is not available when an end image is connected.
duration.title: Duration

end_image_url.description: URL of the image used as the last frame of the video (PNG, JPEG, or WebP). Requires a start image.
end_image_url.title: End Image Url

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

image_url.description: URL of the image the video starts from (PNG, JPEG, or WebP).
image_url.title: Image Url

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the video you want to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

safety_tolerance.description: How permissive the safety filter is. 0 is the strictest and 4 is the most permissive.
safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance
